statement: Sensor wiring on the 2024-2025 250, 350 and 450 SX-F and XC-F. The three-wire sensors share a blue supply wire and a black ground wire. topic: Power, charging, starting and fuel circuit
statement: Power circuit on the 2024-2025 250, 350 and 450 SX-F and XC-F. The alternator feeds the voltage regulator, whose output is white/red and whose ground is brown. White/red is the unswitched battery feed: it runs to the capacitor, the starter relay with its 10 A main fuse, and the power relay. The power relay is switched by the control unit on white/black and sends switched power out on orange to the control unit, the injection valve, the hour counter and a second fuse marked 5 A. From that fuse a blue/orange wire feeds the fuel pump, which the control unit switches on blue/gray. The injection valve gets orange power and is switched on black/gray. The starter button on the right combination switch sends red/blue to the starter relay; the switch's other wire to the control unit is white/gray. Heavy black cables join battery, starter relay and starter motor. Brown is ground throughout.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.
